_comment: Template for ~/.claude/skills/cafe/profile.json. The barista creates this on first run. Each addon is a top-level block, self-contained — block present = addon enabled, block absent = addon off.
_addon_comment: ado.projects[] carries { name, repos: [...] } per project. Off-by-default addons (m365) are omitted entirely from the profile until the user opts them in via the barista.
_budget_comment: preferences.budget_ms is the soft cap on total brief wall-time. Catalog entries in addons/<name>.md carry per-call ms estimates; the barista warns at add-time when enabling a new call would push the predicted total over budget_ms. Default 5000ms is in the Web Vitals 'acceptable' range; raise if you tolerate slower briefs for richer content.
_enabled_calls_comment: Each enabled addon block carries enabled_calls[] — the catalog IDs (e.g. ADO.1, GIT.2, M365.3) currently active for this user. Seeded from each addon's 'Defaults' section in addons/<name>.md during barista onboarding; thereafter the profile is authoritative. The user toggles individual calls via /cafe barista.
_version_comment: version 3 dropped the legacy 'role' field; a v2 profile on disk is silently migrated (role removed, version bumped) by the barista on first encounter.

identity._addressing_comment: preferred_name = how the brief addresses you (header, glykos greeting, nudges). Defaults to first token of git.name when set by the barista. vocative = optional Greek vocative form ('Πάβλο') — Sofia uses it only when explicitly set; null means address in plain English.
